newsitem.title: USA: Glickman sees new Forest Service head by January.
newsitem.headline: Glickman sees new Forest Service head by January.

text.p: Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Tuesday he has been interviewing candidates to head the Forest Service and hopes to name a new Forest Service Chief by the first of next year.
"I'm hopeful that we can announce the new head of the Forest Service by the first of the year," Glickman said in an interview.
The previous chief, Jack Ward Thomas, resigned October 10 to take up an academic post.
Glickman said that the appointment does not require Senate confirmation.
He noted that the Forest Service Agency is the largest department in the USDA, and that it is a critical job "in a time of transition."

He said the post of departing Under Secretary of Agriculture Gene Moos will take longer to fill. Glickman said that the department will compile its list of top candidates soon, but that selection will be after the presidential inauguration.
